issues.quote: Last month, blizzard, you were here all night, right?

issues.quote: January, year one. You stayed all night because the highway closed

issues.what: Verna's make-them-say-April scene is replayed as if ch4 never happened
issues.quote: You two talked around April for months. Now April is here.

issues.quote: his glasses would have fogged if he wore glasses

issues.what: Home contradicts ch1 (lives alone in Cheticamp vs over a garage in Halifax)
issues.quote: I live alone over the garage in Halifax.

issues.quote: North Bay to Thunder Bay. East, not west.

issues.quote: I told her to be good at it. At noticing.

issues.what: Wes asks when Aurele asked dispatch, though Aurele told him on the phone in ch3; Wes 'selling the diner' he does not own; burn called new; Daria 'Fifteen now'
'Last A bag' then twelve bags of A berries; 'fifty next year' for a 47-year-old; Thunder Bay recalled as rain and a booth
issues.quote: twelve bags of berries with A on them

issues.what: Real brands (Freightliner, Greyhound, Banff Springs, Safeway, Husky); 'braces handwriting' tic; 'chest ached...nothing to do with cold' repeated ch2-4; title 'The Pay Phone' belongs to ch3

fix: Replace-level edits across all five chapters: realign ninth-day dates and weekdays, remove glasses, fix Cheticamp home, Ontario route/time zones, foil detail, reversed quote, ch5 blizzard recollection and the repeated April scene, berry-bag and age slips, brands; retitle all five chapters.
praise: Aurele and Wes's tenderness lives in foil, lemon and a pay-phone cord - the Thunder Bay call is the best chapter in the batch.
